## The rules

<!-- CONTRIBUTING.md explains all four. Delete the lines that do not apply. -->

- [ ] This adds a command, and removing it would make a real task *harder* — an
      existing command with a flag would not do
- [ ] This changes what cairn writes to disk, and `spec/README.md` is edited in
      this pull request
- [ ] This adds a documented key, and here is why a schema field would not do:
      <!-- A documented key is a word every project must live with, and it
           costs a format number to change. A schema field costs nothing. -->
- [ ] None of these applies

## Verification

<!-- What you ran, and what it told you. `make check` covers the suite; say if
     you also exercised something by hand. -->

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Behaviour the README demo shows is unchanged, or `make record` was re-run
- [ ] New behaviour has a test that would fail without it
